name: hcapp_snoozePromotion
description: Records that a user has snoozed a promotion until a given date. The authentication check is fully commented out — this SP is effectively unauthenticated. No success/failure rowset is returned.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Device UUID. Used only to resolve @userId from HC.Device — not used for auth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth token. Accepted but never validated — the CHECK_ACCESS_TOKEN call is commented out.

parameters.name: snoozeUntilDate
parameters.description: Date until which the promotion is snoozed.
parameters.typeMismatch: DATETIME parameter — HC convention uses DATETIMEOFFSET throughout. Likely mismatch with the column type.

codeSmells.issue: Authentication check is fully commented out
codeSmells.detail: The entire IF HC.CHECK_ACCESS_TOKEN(...) block is commented out. Any caller who can resolve a userId via any deviceId can snooze any promotion for that user. The commented code also references the older HC.CHECK_ACCESS_TOKEN (not V2).

codeSmells.issue: No return rowset — silent success or failure
codeSmells.detail: No SELECT is executed after the INSERT. The caller receives no confirmation that the snooze was recorded, and no error indication if the INSERT fails.
All other date parameters in the codebase use DATETIMEOFFSET. DATETIME has no timezone info and only 1/300 second precision. Should be DATETIMEOFFSET(7) to match the project standard.

codeSmells.issue: No duplicate guard — multiple snooze rows possible for same user+promotion
codeSmells.detail: No INSERT...WHERE NOT EXISTS or ON DUPLICATE KEY handling. If the app calls this multiple times, the table accumulates duplicate snooze records for the same promotion.
